verdana;"><b>Conclusione</b>:&nbsp;</span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="text-align: left;">→</span><span style="text-align: left;">&nbsp;</span>il termine <u>barra dell'errore</u>&nbsp;o <u>errorbar</u> indica semplicemente l'espediente grafico impiegato per rappresentare attorno al valore di una statistica i suoi&nbsp;<b>limiti di confidenza</b>&nbsp;al livello di probabilità desiderato, che il più delle volte viene fissato al 95%</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">;</span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="text-align: left;">→</span><span style="text-align: left;">&nbsp;</span></span><span style="font-family: verdana;">i&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;"><u>limiti di confidenza al 95% della <b>distribuzione</b> campionaria</u></span><span style="font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;–&nbsp;calcolati come&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">media±</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">1.96∙ds (</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">deviazione standard)</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;– sono&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">i limiti all'interno dei quali cade il 95% dei valori osservati nel campione esaminato, quindi la probabilità che un dato risulti al di fuori di questi limiti è del 5%;</span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="text-align: left;">→</span><span style="text-align: left;">&nbsp;</span>i <u>limiti di confidenza al 95% della <b>media</b>&nbsp;campionaria</u> –&nbsp;calcolati come&nbsp;media±1.96∙es (errore standard) – sono i limiti all'interno dei quali abbiamo il 95% di probabilità che cada la media, quindi la probabilità che la media che andiamo ricercando risulti al di fuori di questi limiti è del 5%&nbsp;(stante l'informazione&nbsp;contenuta nel nostro campione). Questi limiti forniscono un <u>test di significatività</u> della differenza tra le medie: quando&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">i limiti di confidenza al 95% di due medie non si sovrappongono, possiamo affermare che tra le due medie esiste una differenza statisticamente significativa. Quindi nel nostro caso possiamo concludere che all'interno di ciascuno degli sport praticati da entrambi i sessi, con una sola eccezione, la concentrazione media dell'emoglobina nelle atlete è significativamente inferiore a quella degli atleti e che la probabilità che questa conclusione sia errata è del 5% o meno;</span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="text-align: left;">→ </span></span><span style="font-family: verdana;">il <u>risultato</u> di una statistica dovrebbe essere sempre riportato con la sua <b>incertezza</b>, espressa in termini dei suoi <u>limiti di confidenza</u>&nbsp;opportunamente specificati: limiti di confidenza al 95%, limiti di confidenza al 99%, media±</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">n∙</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">ds, media</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">±</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">n∙</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">es, ove n è l'opportuno moltiplicatore, eccetera</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">.</span></div></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div></span></div><div><br /></div><div style="text-align: center;"><span margin-right: 1em;"><img border="0" data-original-height="713" data-original-width="693" height="400" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEg8fyqdsyk7Fc2Q7xMqQGdlaDQRDn-UuHTwQ9WerhXK7Tqyam9o7hJcIw6AYdAcQQJDOY3adhLX01Gcb5ATspK_ThHfb1SbWsekBQEVitP9xMEt5XEVo4kWp45OtijIMCuAFoov2I8r0csQRC7gUHlD33yVEMSa2qGFP6eP_5NCu5n2oe8A_r5TTXUch5VQ/w389-h400/RD01_estrazA.png" width="389" /></a></div></div><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;"><br /></div><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">Ma non basta, perché al bisogno con la funzione </span><b style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="color: #cc0000;">split()</span></b><span style="font-family: verdana;"> è possibile separare i dati per più fattori: nel nostro caso possiamo separare i&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">valori di concentrazione dell'emoglobina</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;contemporaneamente per i due fattori sport e sesso.</span></div><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><div style="background: rgb(221, 221, 221); border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;">#</div><div style="background: rgb(221, 221, 221); border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"># estrae e separa i valori di hg in base al fattore sport e al fattore sesso</div><div style="background: rgb(221, 221, 221); border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;">#</div><div style="background: rgb(221, 221, 221); border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;"><span>hg_sport_sesso</span>&nbsp;&lt;- split(ais$hg,<span>&nbsp;list(ais$sport, ais$sex), drop=TRUE</span>)</span></b>&nbsp;</div><div style="background: rgb(221, 221, 221); border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;">#</div></span></div><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="font-family: verdana;">Le cose da fare in questo caso sono:</div><div style="font-family: verdana;">→ impiegare la funzione <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">list()</span></b>&nbsp;per elencare i fattori in base ai quali i dati devono essere suddivisi, nel nostro caso sia lo sport praticato (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">ais$sport)</span></b> sia il sesso (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">ais$sex)</span></b>;</div><div style="font-family: verdana;">→ aggiungere <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">drop=TRUE</span></b> per scartare i sottoinsiemi vuoti, nel nostro caso invece di 20 sottoinsiemi (10 sport x 2 sessi) avremo solamente 17 sottoinsiemi perché dei dieci sport le donne ne praticano 9 e gli uomini ne praticano 8.</div><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="font-family: verdana; text-align: justify;">Ora con la funzione <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">str()</span></b>&nbsp;si può avere la conferma che nell'oggetto <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">hg_sport_sesso</span></b> si trovano i 17 sottoinsiemi ricavati dalla scomposizione dei valori di concentrazione dell'emoglobina sia per sport sia per sesso:</div><div style="font-family: verdana; text-align: justify;"><br /></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><div><span style="color: #cc0000; font-family: courier;">&gt; str(hg_sport_sesso)</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">List of 17</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;$ B_Ball.f : num [1:13] 12.3 12.7 11.6 12.6 14 12.5 12.8 13.2 13.5 12.7 ...</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;$ Field.f&nbsp; : num [1:7] 13.3 14.7 15.3 14.3 14.6 15 15.2</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;$ Gym.f&nbsp; &nbsp; : num [1:4] 13.4 14 12.5 14.5</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;$ Netball.f: num [1:23] 13.6 12.7 12.3 12.3 12.8 11.8 12.7 12.4 12.4 14.1 ...</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;$ Row.f&nbsp; &nbsp; : num [1:22] 13.9 14.7 13.3 12.9 14.7 14.3 14.5 13 12.5 14.5 ...</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;$ Swim.f&nbsp; &nbsp;: num [1:9] 13.8 13.3 12.9 12.7 14.4 14 13.9 14 13.1</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;$ T_400m.f : num [1:11] 15.9 12.4 14.7 13.9 13 13.8 13.2 12.6 13.5 13.7 ...</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;$ T_Sprnt.f: num [1:4] 13.4 14.4 14.7 14.2</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;$ Tennis.f : num [1:7] 12 13.9 13.5 12.1 14.8 14.5 13.9</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;$ B_Ball.m : num [1:12] 15.9 15.6 15.9 15.7 16.4 14.4 13.7 15.9 13.5 15 ...</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;$ Field.m&nbsp; : num [1:12] 15.4 16.7 15.5 14.7 18 16.1 15.9 16.3 15.8 15.7 ...</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;$ Row.m&nbsp; &nbsp; : num [1:15] 15 14.8 14.5 15.5 14.7 15.4 16.2 14.9 17.3 15.8 ...</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;$ Swim.m&nbsp; &nbsp;: num [1:13] 15.9 15.2 15.9 15 15.6 15.2 16.3 15.2 16.5 15.4 ...</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;$ T_400m.m : num [1:18] 14.4 14 15.1 16.5 16.1 15 15.4 15.4 15.8 14.3 ...</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;$ T_Sprnt.m: num [1:11] 15.6 15.2 15.5 15.5 14.9 19.2 15.1 14.9 17.2 16.5 ...</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;$ Tennis.m : num [1:4] 17.7 14.3 14.9 15.7</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;$ W_Polo.m : num [1:17] 14.4 15.2 15 16.2 15.6 16.2 14.8 15.8 14.4 15.8 ...</span></div></div><div style="font-family: verdana; text-align: justify;"><br /></div><div style="font-family: verdana; text-align: justify;">ed è quindi possibile, automaticamente per tutti i sottoinsiemi, effettuare il test di normalità e rappresentare i boxplot con le funzioni di cui sopra, semplicemente sostituendo&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">hg_sport</span></b> con <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">hg_sport_sesso</span></b>.&nbsp;</div><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><b>La conclusione?</b>&nbsp;Quando si inizia a lavorare con <b>R</b> molte volte ci si arena su problemi banali per i quali esistono soluzioni delle quali non si è a conoscenza data la vastità del linguaggio. Un esempio ne è l'estrazione dei dati per fattore&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">da un set di dati</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">mediante la funzione </span><b style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="color: #cc0000;">split()</span></b><span style="font-family: verdana;">, che consente&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">–&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">indicando la variabile da estrarre e il fattore (o congiuntamente con </span><b style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="color: #cc0000;">list()</span></b><span style="font-family: verdana;"> i fattori) in base al quale separare i dati&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">–&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">di </span><b style="font-family: verdana;">preparare i dati</b><span style="font-family: verdana;"> organizzandoli in un formato utile ai fini della loro successiva analisi statistica e della loro rappresentazione grafica.</span></div><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;"><br /></div></div></div></span></div></div></span></div></span></div></div></div></span></div></div></span></div></div></div></div><div style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">----------</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: Besozzihttp://www.blogger.com/profile/05629934994166329872noreply@blogger.com0tag:blogger.com,1999:blog-5064257345139522345.post-660577369087279322025-07-20T14:07:00.018+02:002025-09-19T18:28:37.934+02:00Come impiegare l'operatore %>% e l'argomento FUN<div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">Anche se l'obiettivo di questi post rimane sempre quello di fornire gli strumenti più semplici, quelli utili nella fase iniziale di apprendimento – notoriamente tutta in salita e nella quale quello che conta è "rompere il ghiaccio" con <b>R</b></span><span style="font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">–</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;occasionalmente può essere interessante affrontare argomenti un poco più tecnici, come i due che vediamo ora.</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><b>L'operatore %&gt;%</b></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">Il simbolo <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">%&gt;%</span></b>&nbsp;viene impiegato per indicare&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">l'</span><u style="font-family: verdana;">operatore</u><span style="font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;</span><b style="font-family: verdana;">pipe</b><span style="font-family: verdana;">:&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">il termine sta per il sostantivo "tubo" ma anche per l'espressione verbale "trasportare con una tubatura", ed è proprio in questo senso che viene impiegato. L'operatore pipe è stato introdotto la prima volta con il pacchetto </span><b style="font-family: verdana;">magrittr</b><span style="font-family: verdana;"> [1] che ne riporta la seguente descrizione:&nbsp;</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">"<i>[il pacchetto] fornisce un meccanismo per concatenare i comandi con il nuovo operatore di inoltro pipe, %&gt;%. Questo operatore inoltrerà un valore, o il risultato di un'espressione, alla successiva chiamata/espressione di funzione. [l'operatore] fornisce un supporto flessibile per il tipo di espressioni sul lato destro. Per ulteriori informazioni, consultare la descrizione del pacchetto. Per citare René Magritte, 'Ceci n'est pas une pipe'. </i>" [2]</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">In altre parole: l'operatore <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">%&gt;%</span></b> fornisce la "tubatura" che consente&nbsp;–&nbsp;in modo completamente trasparente per il programmatore</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">–</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">di inoltrare i dati in uscita da una funzione all'ingresso della funzione che segue. Vediamo questo breve esempio. Abbiamo il set di dati </span><b style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="color: #cc0000;">ais</span></b><span style="font-family: verdana;"> [3]&nbsp;</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span><div><span style="color: #cc0000; font-family: courier;">&gt; ais</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;rcc&nbsp; wcc&nbsp; &nbsp;hc&nbsp; &nbsp;hg ferr&nbsp; &nbsp;bmi&nbsp; &nbsp;ssf pcBfat&nbsp; &nbsp; lbm&nbsp; &nbsp; ht&nbsp; &nbsp; wt sex&nbsp; &nbsp;sport</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">1&nbsp; &nbsp;3.96&nbsp; 7.5 37.5 12.3&nbsp; &nbsp;60 20.56 109.1&nbsp; 19.75&nbsp; 63.32 195.9&nbsp; 78.9&nbsp; &nbsp;f&nbsp; B_Ball</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">…...</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">202 5.38&nbsp; 6.3 46.0 15.7&nbsp; &nbsp;32 21.07&nbsp; 34.9&nbsp; &nbsp;6.26&nbsp; 72.00 190.8&nbsp; 76.7&nbsp; &nbsp;m&nbsp; Tennis</span></div><div style="font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;</div></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">e vogliamo calcolare la media, la deviazione standard e l'errore standard della concentrazione di emoglobina (</span><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">hg</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">) nel sangue dei 202 atleti australiani ivi inclusi suddividendoli per sport praticato (</span><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">sport</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">) e per sesso (</span><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">sex</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">).</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">Copiate e incollate nella</span><span style="font-family: courier;"> Console di R </span><span style="font-family: verdana;">questo script e premete</span><span style="font-family: courier;"> ↵ Invio</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">.</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><div style="text-align: left;"><div style="text-align: justify;"><div style="background: rgb(221, 221, 221); border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">library (DAAG)</span></b> # carica il pacchetto che include il set di dati ais</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">library(dplyr)</span></b> # carica il pacchetto con l'operatore pipe e altre funzioni</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">pipe_hg &lt;- ais %&gt;% group_by(sport, sex) %&gt;% summarise(media=mean(hg), ds=sd(hg), es=std.error(hg)) %&gt;% ungroup()</span></b></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;">#</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">pipe_hg</span></b> # mostra i risultati</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;">#</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;">Dopo avere installato e caricato i pacchetti necessari, per realizzare la tabella che contiene i risultati desiderati impieghiamo più volte l'operatore pipe (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">%&gt;%</span></b>), che trasferisce i dati da una funzione alla successiva in questo modo:</span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">→ i dati (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">ais</span></b>) sono trasferiti (</span><b style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="color: #cc0000;">%&gt;%</span></b><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">) alla funzione&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">group_by()</span></b>;</span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">→ la funzione&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">group_by()</span></b></span><span style="font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">–</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">che&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">raggruppa i dati in sottoinsiemi per sport praticato (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">sport</span></b>) e per sesso dell'atleta (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">sex</span></b>)<span style="text-align: justify;">&nbsp;–&nbsp;trasferisce</span>&nbsp;il risultato di questa operazione (</span><b style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="color: #cc0000;">%&gt;%</span></b><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">) alla funzione&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">summarise()</span></b>;</span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">→ la funzione&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">summarise()</span></b>&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">calcola la media&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">mean()</span></b>, la deviazione standard&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">sd()</span></b>&nbsp;e l'errore standard <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">std.error()</span></b> della variabile&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">hg</span></b>&nbsp;– la concentrazione nel sangue dell'emoglobina (espressa in g/dL, grammi per decilitro di sangue) dei 202 atleti australiani suddivisi per sport e per sesso – e trasferisce il risultato di questa operazione&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">(</span><b style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="color: #cc0000;">%&gt;%</span></b><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">) alla funzione&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">ungroup()</span></b>;</span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">→ </span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">la funzione&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">ungroup()</span></b>&nbsp;rimuove una serie di valori impiegati provvisoriamente per generare il risultato finale, che viene infine salvato (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">&lt;-</span></b>) n</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">ella tabella&nbsp;</span><b style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;"><span style="color: #cc0000;">pipe_hg</span></b><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">.</span></div></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></span></div><div style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">Ed ecco la tabella risultante, ottenuta quindi con una sola riga di codice:</span></div><div style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: left;"><span style="text-align: justify;"><span style="color: #cc0000; font-family: courier;">&gt; pipe_hg # mostra i risultati</span></span></div><div><span><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;"># A tibble: 17 × 5</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp; &nbsp;sport&nbsp; &nbsp;sex&nbsp; &nbsp;media&nbsp; &nbsp; ds&nbsp; &nbsp; es</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp; &nbsp;&lt;fct&gt;&nbsp; &nbsp;&lt;fct&gt; &lt;dbl&gt; &lt;dbl&gt; &lt;dbl&gt;</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;1 B_Ball&nbsp; f&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 13.1 0.878 0.243</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;7 Row&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;f&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 14.0 0.740 0.158</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;8 Row&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;m&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 14.2 0.556 0.278</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">14 T_Sprnt m&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 16.2 1.49&nbsp; 0.450</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">15 Tennis&nbsp; f&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 13.5 1.10&nbsp; 0.414</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">16 Tennis&nbsp; m&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 15.6 1.48&nbsp; 0.741</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">17 W_Polo&nbsp; m&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; 15.5 0.718 0.174</span></div><div style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></div><div style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></div></span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><b>L'argomento FUN</b></span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;">L'<u>argomento</u> <b><span>FUN</span></b>&nbsp;consente di specificare una o più funzioni e di applicarle in sequenza a una variabile. Per illustrarlo impieghiamo gli stessi dati dell'esempio precedente allo stesso scopo:&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">calcolare la media, la deviazione standard e l'errore standard della concentrazione di emoglobina nel sangue di 202 atleti australiani suddividendoli per sport praticato e per sesso.&nbsp;</span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;">Copiate e incollate nella</span><span style="font-family: courier;"> Console di R </span><span style="font-family: verdana;">questo script e premete</span><span style="font-family: courier;"> ↵ Invio</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">.</span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;"><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><div style="text-align: left;"><div style="text-align: justify;"><div style="background: rgb(221, 221, 221); margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;">#</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b>library (DAAG)</b> # carica il pacchetto che include il set di dati ais</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b>library(plotrix)</b> # carica il pacchetto per il calcolo dell'errore standard</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;">#</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"># calcola media, deviazione standard ed errore standard separatamente per sport e per sesso</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;">#</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">FUN_hg &lt;- aggregate(hg~sport+sex, data=ais, FUN=function(x) c(media=mean(x), ds=sd(x), es=std.error(x)))&nbsp;</span></b></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">FUN_hg</span></b> # mostra i risultati&nbsp;</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;">#</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div></div></div></div></span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;">Dopo avere installato e caricato i pacchetti necessari, la tabella che contiene i risultati desiderati viene realizzata con la funzione <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">aggregate()</span></b> che nell'ordine:</span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">→ nel nostro set di dati (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">data=ais</span></b>)&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">raggruppa (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">~</span></b>) i valori di concentrazione dell'emoglobina (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">hg</span></b>) in sottoinsiemi per sport praticato (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">sport</span></b>) e per sesso dell'atleta (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">sex</span></b>)</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">;</span></span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="text-align: left;">→</span><span style="text-align: left;">&nbsp;con&nbsp;</span>l'argomento <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">FUN</span></b>&nbsp;e con il valore&nbsp;</span><b style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="color: #cc0000;">=function(x)</span></b><span style="font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;specifica che sui dati devono essere effettuati i calcoli di seguito elencati;</span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">→</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">&nbsp;con la funzione <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">c()</span></b> elenca le funzioni da impiegare per i calcoli;</span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">→</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">&nbsp;con&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">le funzioni <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">mean()</span></b>, <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">sd()</span></b> e <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">std.error()</span></b>&nbsp;effettua i calcoli di media, deviazione standard ed errore standard sui dati raggruppati per sport e per sesso, salvando i risultati</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;nelle variabili <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">media</span></b>, <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">ds</span></b> ed&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">es</span></b>.&nbsp;</span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;">I risultati&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">sono infine riportati (</span><b style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;"><span style="color: #cc0000;">&lt;-</span></b><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">) nella tabella&nbsp;</span><b style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="color: #cc0000;">FUN_hg</span></b><span style="font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;e, a parte l'ordinamento e gli arrotondamenti, sono identici a quelli ottenuti con lo script precedente, impiegando anche in questo caso una sola riga di codice.</span></div></div></span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div><span><div><span style="color: #cc0000; font-family: courier;">&gt; FUN_hg # mostra i risultati&nbsp;</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;sport sex&nbsp; &nbsp;hg.media&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; For more information, see package vignette. To quote Rene Magritte, 'Ceci n'est pas un pipe.'</i> ".</span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><span>[3]&nbsp;</span><span>Vedere il post&nbsp;</span><a href="https://impararfacendo.blogspot.com/2018/11/il-set-di-dati-ais.html" target="_blank">Il set di dati ais</a><span>&nbsp;</span><span>nel quale trovate anche come caricare i dati senza impiegare il pacchetto&nbsp;<b>DAAG</b>.&nbsp;</span></span></div><div><br /></div></div>Marco Besozzihttp://www.blogger.com/profile/05629934994166329872noreply@blogger.com0tag:blogger.com,1999:blog-5064257345139522345.post-25639995828184886172025-06-13T08:00:00.002+02:002025-06-30T09:33:42.449+02:00Grafici a barre (barplot) con ggplot<div style="font-family: verdana; text-align: justify;">I&nbsp;<b>grafici a barre</b>&nbsp;(<i>bar plot</i>&nbsp;o&nbsp;<i>barplot</i>) si possono realizzare impiegando le funzioni base di <b>R</b> [1]. Tuttavia con il pacchetto&nbsp;<b>ggplot2</b>&nbsp;si possono ottenere risultati molto interessanti, qui illustrati con tre script che si aggiungono ad altri già riportati [2] e che, quando si è agli inizi, possono aiutare a familiarizzare con le funzioni di questo pacchetto.</div><div style="font-family: verdana; text-align: justify;"><br /></div><div style="font-family: verdana; text-align: justify;">Come trovate riportato nel manuale di riferimento del pacchetto [3] "<i>... Esistono due tipi di grafici a barre:&nbsp;<b>geom_bar()</b>&nbsp;e&nbsp;<b>geom_col()</b>&nbsp;... geom_bar() rende l'altezza della barra proporzionale al numero di casi in ogni gruppo ... Se volete che le altezze delle barre rappresentino i valori nei dati, usate geom_col() al suo posto</i>".</div><div style="font-family: verdana; text-align: justify;"><br /></div><div style="font-family: verdana; text-align: justify;">Oltre al pacchetto&nbsp;<b>ggplot2</b>&nbsp;[4] dovete accertarvi di avere installato – o dovete scaricare anche – il pacchetto&nbsp;<b>DAAG</b>&nbsp;[5] che contiene il set di dati&nbsp;<span style="color: #cc0000;"><b>ais</b></span>&nbsp;impiegati nell'esempio, il pacchetto&nbsp;<b>RColorBrewer</b> che contiene una serie di palette (raccolte di colori) aggiuntive e il pacchetto&nbsp;<b>gridExtra</b>&nbsp;che consente di combinare i grafici in una sola figura.</div><div style="font-family: verdana; text-align: justify;"><br /></div><div style="font-family: verdana; text-align: justify;"><b>Le altezze delle barre rappresentano i valori numerici dei dati</b></div><div style="font-family: verdana; text-align: justify;"><br /></div><div style="font-family: verdana; text-align: justify;">Per questo tipo di rappresentazione si impiega la funzione&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">geom_col()</span></b>.&nbsp;&nbsp;<span style="font-family: verdana;">Copiate e incollate nella</span><span style="font-family: courier;">&nbsp;Console di R&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">questo script</span><span style="background-color: white; font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;</span><span style="background-color: white; font-family: verdana;">e premete</span><span style="background-color: white;"><span style="font-family: courier;">&nbsp;↵ Invio</span></span><span style="font-family: verdana;">.</span></div><span><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><div style="text-align: left;"><div style="text-align: justify;"><div style="background: rgb(221, 221, 221); border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"># BARPLOT con ggplot&nbsp;</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"># barplot semplici</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;">#</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">library(ggplot2)</span></b> # carica il pacchetto per la grafica</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">library(RColorBrewer)</span></b> # carica il pacchetto con le palette aggiuntive</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">library(gridExtra)</span></b> # carica il pacchetto per combinare i grafici in una sola figura</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;">#</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"># genera la tabella con i dati da rappresentare</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">mydata &lt;- data.frame(loc=c("Milano", "Catania", "Roma"), temp=c(18.3, 26.8, 21.2))</span></b></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;">#</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"># barplot di base</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">plot1 &lt;- ggplot(data=mydata, aes(x=loc, y=temp)) + geom_col()</span></b></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;">#</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"># scambia tra loro gli assi</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">plot2</span> &lt;- ggplot(data=mydata, aes(x=loc, y=temp<span style="color: #cc0000;">, fill=as.factor(temp)</span>)) + geom_col(<span style="color: #cc0000;">width=0.6</span>) <span style="color: #cc0000;">+ ylim(0, 30) + labs(x="Località", y="Temperatura in gradi Celsius") + theme(legend.position="bottom") + scale_fill_discrete(name="°C") + coord_flip()</span></b></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;">#</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"># riporta i valori numerici in testa alle barre</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">plot3</span> &lt;- ggplot(data=mydata, aes(x=loc, y=temp)) + geom_col(width=0.6<span style="color: #cc0000;">, fill="steelblue3</span>") + ylim(0, 30) + labs(x="Località", y="Temperatura in gradi Celsius") <span style="color: #cc0000;">+ scale_x_discrete(limits=c("Milano", "Roma", "Catania")) + geom_text(aes(label=temp), vjust=-0.6, color="black", size=3.2)</span></b></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;">#</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"># applica alle barre un gradiente di colori</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">plot4</span> &lt;- ggplot(data=mydata, aes(x=loc, y=temp, fill=as.factor(temp))) + geom_col(width=0.6) + ylim(0, 30) + labs(x="Località", y="Temperatura in gradi Celsius") + scale_x_discrete(limits=c("Milano", "Roma", "Catania")) <span style="color: #cc0000;">+ theme_classic() + scale_fill_brewer(palette="Blues") + labs(fill="°C")</span></b></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;">#</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"># combina i grafici in una sola figura</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">grid.arrange(plot1, plot2, plot3, plot4, nrow=2, ncol=2)</span></b></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;">#</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div></div></div></div></span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div><span style="text-align: left;"><div><span><div style="font-family: verdana; text-align: justify;">Dopo avere caricato i pacchetti necessari, sono generati&nbsp;<span style="font-family: verdana;">i dati impiegati come esempio (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">mydata</span></b>):</span></div><div style="font-family: verdana; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; loc temp</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">1&nbsp; Milano 18.3</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">2 Catania 26.8</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">3&nbsp; &nbsp; Roma 21.2</span></div><div style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></div></span></div><div style="font-family: verdana; text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">Per realizzare il&nbsp;<u>primo grafico</u>&nbsp;(<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">plot1</span></b>) viene impiegata innanzitutto la funzione&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">ggplot()</span></b></span><span style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">–</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;che&nbsp;</span>inizializza l'oggetto al quale sono collegate con il segno più [<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">+</span></b>] le successive funzioni, che sviluppano la grafica&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">–</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;che prevede:</span></div></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">→ come primo argomento il nome della tabella che contiene i dati (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">mydata</span></b>);</span></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="background-color: white;">→</span><span style="background-color: white;">&nbsp;</span><span>come secondo argomento la funzione&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">aes()</span></b>&nbsp;che specifica di riportare in ascisse (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">x=</span></b>) la variabile (fattore)&nbsp;</span><span style="color: #cc0000;"><b>loc</b></span><span>&nbsp;che indica la località e in ordinate (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">y=</span></b>) la variabile (numerica)&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;"><span>temp</span></span></b>&nbsp;che riporta la temperatura rilevata espressa in <i>gradi Celsius</i> (°C).&nbsp;</span></span><span style="font-family: verdana;">Alla funzione&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">ggplot()</span></b>&nbsp;viene quindi collegata&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">con il segno più [</span><b style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="color: #cc0000;">+</span></b><span style="font-family: verdana;">]&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">la funzione&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">geom_col()</span></b>&nbsp;che realizza come detto il grafico a barre nel quale le altezze delle barre rappresentano i valori numerici dei dati.</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">Questa è la struttura base che rimane identica in tutti e quattro i grafici realizzati, che si differenziano tra loro per le personalizzazioni grafiche via via introdotte.</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">Il&nbsp;<u>secondo grafico</u>&nbsp;(<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">plot2</span></b>) aggiunge:</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="text-align: left;">→ la colorazione automatica delle barre con un colore diverso per ogni località (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">fill=loc</span></b>);</span></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="text-align: left;">→ la riduzione dell'ampiezza della barre con <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">width=0.6</span></b>;</span></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="text-align: left;">→ la personalizzazione della scala delle ordinate che ora va da <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">0</span></b> a <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">30</span></b>;</span></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="text-align: left;">→ la funzione&nbsp;</span></span><b style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;"><span style="color: #cc0000;">labs()</span></b><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">&nbsp;che specifica le etichette</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">&nbsp;delle ascisse e delle ordinate;</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="text-align: left;">→ la funzione <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">theme()</span></b> che specifica la posizione in basso (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">"bottom"</span></b>) per la legenda;</span></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="text-align: left;">→ il titolo <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">°C</span></b> della legenda con la funzione&nbsp;</span></span><span style="text-align: left;"><span style="color: #cc0000; font-family: verdana;"><b>scale_fill_discrete()</b></span></span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">;</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="text-align: left;">→ la funzione&nbsp;</span></span><span style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">coord_flip()</span></b> che scambia tra di loro la posizione degli assi.</span></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">Nel&nbsp;<u>terzo grafico</u>&nbsp;(<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">plot3</span></b>):</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><div><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">→ con&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">fill="steelblue3"</span></b>&nbsp;viene specificato manualmente il colore delle barre;</span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">→ con <span style="color: #cc0000;"><b>scale_x_discrete()</b></span> viene specificato manualmente l'ordine delle barre;</span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">→ con </span><span><span style="font-family: verdana;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">geom_text()</span></b> in testa a ciascuna barra viene riportata la temperatura corripondente (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">temp</span></b>) specificando posizione (<span style="color: #cc0000;"><b>vjust</b></span>), colore (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">color</span></b>) e dimensione (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">size</span></b>) dei caratteri.</span></span></span></div></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><br /></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;"><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">Il&nbsp;<u>quarto grafico</u>&nbsp;(<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">plot4</span></b>) ricalca il terzo grafico e in aggiunta:</span></div><div style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;;"><div><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">→ con&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">theme_classic()</span></b>&nbsp;ripristina la struttura classica impiegata nei grafici;</span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">→ con&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">scale_fill_brewer()</span></b> applica il gradiente di colori della palette <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">Blues</span></b>;</span></div></div></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">→ con&nbsp;</span><span style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">labs()</span></b>&nbsp;riporta nella legenda il titolo <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">°C</span></b>.</span></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><br /></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">Infine con la funzione&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">grid.arrange()</span></b>&nbsp;i quattro grafici sono combinati in un'unica figura.</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><br /></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"><a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEj5QyUxDnT7WFg_n8Uug-NQfARrbWN3aToa81c4z4pUB1iSaXvHEt9e2z0Jw53yGx7t98810-XXU5Vhb3MeUzFRES8O68KXQsuzNXi101bwjhFUboVV6sdh1aEnQK5p_Fn5N6aQKOE5PdO7uzs0RGUfWtWLVlq9JvRCHPBmm6qU8X8MA7aAEfMRfPIU8vPF/s715/U236_ggplot2bar_plotA.png" rgb(221, 221, 221); border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; style="color: #cc0000;">plot1 &lt;- ggplot(data=hgb, aes(x=sport, y=hg)) + geom_col(fill="steelblue3") + ylim(0, 20) + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, hjust=1))</span></b>&nbsp;</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"># scambia tra loro gli assi</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">plot2</span> &lt;- ggplot(data=hgb, aes(x=sport, y=hg)) + geom_col(<span style="color: #cc0000;">width=0.8,</span> fill="steelblue3") + ylim(0, 20) <span style="color: #cc0000;">+ coord_flip()</span></b></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;">#</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"># riporta i valori numerici all'interno delle barre</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">plot3</span> &lt;- ggplot(data=hgb, aes(x=<span style="color: #cc0000;">reorder(sport, -hg)</span>, y=hg)) + geom_col(width=0.8, fill="steelblue3") + ylim(0, 20) <span style="color: #cc0000;">+ geom_text(aes(label=hg), vjust=1.6, color="white", size=2.8) + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, hjust=1)) + theme(legend.position="none") + labs(title="Mediana dell'emoglobina \n per sport", x="Sport praticato", y="Emoglobina in g/dL")</span></b></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;">#</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"># applica alle barre un gradiente di colori</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">mycolors &lt;- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Blues"))(40)[11:20]</span></b> # porta da 9 a 40 i colori della palette e seleziona i 10 colori da 11 a 20</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">plot4</span> &lt;- ggplot(data=hgb, aes(x=reorder(sport, hg), y=hg<span style="color: #cc0000;">, fill=as.factor(hg)</span>)) + geom_col(width=0.8) <span style="color: #cc0000;">+ theme_classic()</span> + ylim(0, 20) + geom_text(aes(label=hg), <span style="color: #cc0000;">vjust=-0.6</span>, color="black", size=<span style="color: #cc0000;">3.2</span>) + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, hjust=1)) + theme(legend.position="none") + labs(title="Mediana dell'emoglobina \n per sport", x="Sport praticato", y="Emoglobina in g/dL") <span style="color: #cc0000;">+ theme(plot.title=element_text(hjust=0.5)) + scale_fill_manual(values=mycolors)</span></b></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;">#</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"># combina i grafici in una sola figura</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b>grid.arrange(plot1, plot2, plot3, plot4, nrow=2, ncol=2)</b>&nbsp;</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;">#</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div></div></div></div></span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div><span style="text-align: left;"><span><div style="text-align: justify;"><div><span style="font-family: verdana;">Innanzitutto sui dati della tabella <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">ais</span></b> contenuta nel pacchetto <b>DAAG</b> è calcolata la mediana (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">median</span></b>) dell'emoglobina per ciascuno sport (<span style="color: #cc0000;"><b>hg~sport</b></span>), salvandola nella nuova tabella <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">hgb</span></b>&nbsp;che viene mostrata e che contiene ora i dati da rappresentare:</span></div><div><span style="color: #cc0000; font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div><span style="font-family: courier;"><div><span style="color: #cc0000;">&gt; hgb # mostra la tabella con i dati da rappresentare</span></div><div style="color: #3d85c6;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;sport&nbsp; &nbsp;hg</div><div style="color: #3d85c6;">1&nbsp; &nbsp;B_Ball 14.0</div><div style="color: #3d85c6;">2&nbsp; &nbsp; Field 15.5</div><div style="color: #3d85c6;">3&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Gym 13.7</div><div style="color: #3d85c6;">4&nbsp; Netball 12.7</div><div style="color: #3d85c6;">5&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Row 14.7</div><div style="color: #3d85c6;">6&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Swim 15.1</div><div style="color: #3d85c6;">7&nbsp; &nbsp;T_400m 14.8</div><div style="color: #3d85c6;">8&nbsp; T_Sprnt 15.2</div><div style="color: #3d85c6;">9&nbsp; &nbsp;Tennis 14.3</div><div style="color: #3d85c6;">10&nbsp; W_Polo 15.6</div></span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;">Nel&nbsp;<u>primo grafico</u>&nbsp;(<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">plot1</span></b>)</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">:</span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">→ sono impiegati i dati della tabella <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">hg</span></b> riportando in ascisse <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">sport</span></b> e in ordinate la mediana <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">hg</span></b> dell'emoglobina</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">;</span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">→ le barre sono colorate tutte con lo stesso colore, specificato in <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">fill</span></b>;</span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">→ con la funzione&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">ylim()</span></b>&nbsp;viene dimensionata la scala delle ordinate da <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">0</span></b> a <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">20</span></b></span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">;</span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">→ con <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">theme()</span></b> le etichette dell'asse delle</span><span style="font-family: courier; text-align: left;"> x </span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">sono riportate in verticale (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">angle=90</span></b>)</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">.</span></div><div><br /></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;">Il&nbsp;</span><u style="font-family: verdana;">secondo grafico</u><span style="font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;(</span><b style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="color: #cc0000;">plot2</span></b><span style="font-family: verdana;">) è identico al precedente a parte il fatto che le barre sono ridotte di ampiezza (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">width=0.8</span></b>) e gli assi sono scambiati tra loro con <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">coord_flip()</span></b></span><span style="background-color: white; font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;per porre le barre in orizzontale.</span></div><div><div style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></div></div><div style="font-family: verdana;">Il&nbsp;<u>terzo grafico</u>&nbsp;(<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">plot3</span></b>) riprende nuovamente il primo con alcune aggiunte e modifiche:</div><div><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">→ le barre sono ordinate ponendo la mediana dell'emoglobina in ordine decrescente (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">-hg</span></b>)</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">;</span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">→ con <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">geom_text()</span></b> sono riportate all'interno delle barre (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">vjust=1.6</span></b>) in colore chiaro (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">white</span></b>), rimpiccolendo lievemente i caratteri (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">size=2.8</span></b>), le etichette con i valori (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">label=hg</span></b>) della mediana dell'emoglobina;</span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">→&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">con&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">theme()</span></b>&nbsp;le etichette dell'asse delle</span><span style="font-family: courier;">&nbsp;x&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">sono riportate in verticale (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">angle=90</span></b>);</span></span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">→ viene esclusa la rappresentazione della legenda (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">"none"</span></b>);</span></span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">→ con <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">labs()</span></b> sono aggiunti il titolo e le etichette degli assi.</span></div><div style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></div><div style="font-family: verdana;">Il&nbsp;<u>quarto grafico</u>&nbsp;(<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">plot4</span></b>) ripresenta il terzo grafico con poche aggiunte e modifiche:</div><div><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">→ innanzitutto sono&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">portati da 9 a 40 i colori della palette, sono selezionati i 10 colori da 11 a 20, e questi sono memorizzati nell'oggetto <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">mycolors</span></b>;</span></div><div style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">→ sono riportati colori diversi per ciascun valore dell'emoglobina con&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">as.factor(hg)</span></b>;</span></div><div style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="text-align: left;">→ viene tolto lo sfondo con <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">theme_classic()</span></b>;</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">→ le etichette con i valori della mediana dell'emoglobina sono portate all'esterno delle barre (</span><span style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">vjust=-0.6</span></b>) aumentando lievemente la dimensione dei caratteri (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">size=3.2</span></b>);</span></span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">→ con&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">hjust=0.5</span></b> il titolo viene centrato;</span></div><div style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="text-align: left;">→ le barre sono riportate nel gradiente di colori memorizzati in <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">mycolors</span></b>.</span></div><div style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="text-align: left;"><br /></span></div><div style="font-family: verdana;">Questi sono i 0cm;"><b>library(DAAG)</b> # carica il pacchetto DAAG che include il set di dati ais</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; 0cm;"><b>library(gridExtra)</b> # carica il pacchetto per combinare i grafici in una sola figura</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"># aggrega i dati calcolando media ed errore standard per sport e per sesso</div><div style="background-attachment: break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">hg &lt;-</span> aggregate(hg~sport<span style="color: #cc0000;">+sex, </span>data=ais<span style="color: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><span style="color: #cc0000;"><b>hg</b></span> # mostra i dati da rappresentare</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">media &lt;- hg$hg[,1]</span></b> # vettore contenente la media</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">es &lt;- style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">plot2</span> &lt;- ggplot(data=hg, aes(x=sport, y=media, fill=sex)) + geom_col(<span style="color: #cc0000;">position=position_dodge()</span>) + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, hjust=1)) + ylim(0, 31)</b></div><div limiti di confidenza al 95% della media</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">plot3</span> &lt;- ggplot(data=hg, aes(x=sport, y=media, fill=sex)) + geom_col(position=position_dodge()) + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, hjust=1)) + ylim(<span style="color: #cc0000;">0, 20</span>) <span style="color: #cc0000;">+ geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=media-1.96*es, ymax=media+1.96*es), width=0.2, position=position_dodge(0.9)) + labs(title="Media dell'emoglobina ± 1.96 es")&nbsp;</span></b></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: aes(x=sport, y=media, fill=sex)) + <span style="color: #cc0000;">geom_point(aes(fill=sex),</span>&nbsp;shape=21, size=3, position=position_dodge(<span style="color: #cc0000;">0.9</span>)) <span style="color: #cc0000;">+ theme_classic()</span> + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, hjust=1)) + ylim(0, 20) + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=media-1.96*es, ymax=media+1.96*es), width=0.2, position=position_dodge(0.9)) + labs(title="Media dell'emoglobina ± 1.96 es"<span style="color: #cc0000;">, x="Sport praticato", y="Emoglobina in g/dL") + scale_fill_discrete(name = "Sesso", labels = background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b>grid.arrange(plot1, plot2, plot3, plot4, nrow=2, ncol=2)&nbsp;</b></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;">#</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div style="font-family: verdana;"></div></div></div></span></div><div style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">In questo caso&nbsp;</span>dai dati della tabella&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">ais</span></b>&nbsp;contenuta nel pacchetto&nbsp;<b>DAAG</b>&nbsp;riportiamo la variabile emoglobina suddivisa per sport e per sesso (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">hg~sport+sex</span></b>) e ne calcoliamo la media (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">mean</span></b>) e l'errore standard (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">std.error</span></b>) – quest'ultima funzione&nbsp;richiede il pacchetto <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">plotrix</span></b> – e questa è la tabella risultante della quale vogliamo rappresentare i grafici a barre:</div><div style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div><span><div><div><span style="color: #cc0000; font-family: courier;">&gt; hg # mostra i dati da rappresentare</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;sport sex&nbsp; &nbsp; hg.mean&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; hg.se</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">1&nbsp; &nbsp;B_Ball&nbsp; &nbsp;f 13.1307692&nbsp; 0.2434750</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">2&nbsp; &nbsp; Field&nbsp; &nbsp;f 14.6285714&nbsp; 0.2579353</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">3&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Gym&nbsp; &nbsp;f 13.6000000&nbsp; 0.4301163</span></div><div><span style="color: 14.0318182&nbsp; 0.1576871</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">6&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Swim&nbsp; &nbsp;f 13.5666667&nbsp; 0.1943651</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">7&nbsp; &nbsp;T_400m&nbsp; &nbsp;f 13.7727273&nbsp; 0.3122036</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">8&nbsp; T_Sprnt&nbsp; &nbsp;f 16.0250000&nbsp; 0.2322893</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">12&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;Row&nbsp; &nbsp;m 15.3866667&nbsp; 0.1835799</span></div><div><span style="color:
