background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">library(DAAG)</span></b> # carica il pacchetto incluso il set di dati ais</span></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">library(car)</span></b> # carica il pacchetto per lo scatterplot</span></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">windows()</span></b> # apre e inizializza una nuova finestra grafica</span></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">#</span></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">scatterplotMatrix(~rcc+wcc+hc+hg+ferr, col="black", pch=20, regLine=list(method=lm, lty=1, lwd=2, col="chartreuse3"), smooth=FALSE, diagonal=list(method="histogram", breaks="FD"), main="Distribuzione dei dati e rette di regressione", data=ais)</span></b> # mostra il grafico</span></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">#</span></div></div></div></div></div></div><div><br /></div><div></div></div></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">Dopo avere caricato il pacchetto (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">DAAG</span></b>) che contiene i dati da analizzare e il pacchetto (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">car</span></b>), con <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">windows()</span></b> viene aperta e inizializzata una nuova finestra nella quale comparirà il grafico predisposto con la funzione <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">scatterplotMatrix()</span></b>&nbsp;nella quarta e ultima riga di codice [5].&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><br /></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"><a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgCMqylKsJ_Zv_Hk6Yrop6NEe048aKUI8Qg7hLPknGG5AtISLiMDqPGcWjmRoPDo4g6lyOuTW50VssI-UFMuVw9w11M4KJj0fL9st2Z_6IfVtbI0sA51CjG1yqpzQOtzF5AOc7U4zbZrTOY_nva16O11V1Pi2LQ_-jG1sebifF3ywOyByfquOljZcMtlUea/s712/U220G_reg_isotone&amp;monregA.png" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"><img border="0" data-original-height="712" data-original-width="691" height="400" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgCMqylKsJ_Zv_Hk6Yrop6NEe048aKUI8Qg7hLPknGG5AtISLiMDqPGcWjmRoPDo4g6lyOuTW50VssI-UFMuVw9w11M4KJj0fL9st2Z_6IfVtbI0sA51CjG1yqpzQOtzF5AOc7U4zbZrTOY_nva16O11V1Pi2LQ_-jG1sebifF3ywOyByfquOljZcMtlUea/w389-h400/U220G_reg_isotone&amp;monregA.png" width="389" /></a></div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">L'analisi preliminare dei dati ci dice che se in alcuni casi la regressione lineare sembra appropriata, in altri lo è molto meno. Qui ci focalizziamo su emoglobina (</span><span style="font-family: courier;">hg</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">) e ferritina (</span><span style="font-family: courier;">ferr</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">) [6] che mostrano distribuzioni dei dati non gaussiane, quindi in linea di principio inadatte all'impiego della regressione lineare ordinaria [7].&nbsp;</span></div></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><br /></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">Ora copiate e incollate nella</span><span style="font-family: courier; text-align: left;">&nbsp;Console di R&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">questo script&nbsp;</span><span style="background-color: white; font-family: verdana;">e premete</span><span style="background-color: white;"><span style="font-family: courier;">&nbsp;↵ Invio</span></span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">.</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><br /></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><div style="text-align: left;"><div style="text-align: justify;"><div style="background: rgb(221, 221, 221); border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"># REGRESSIONE MONOTÒNA (ISOTÒNA) con il pacchetto isotone&nbsp;</div><div>#</div></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><b>library(DAAG)</b> # carica il pacchetto che include il set di dati ais</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><b>library(<span style="color: #cc0000;">isotone</span>)</b> # carica il pacchetto per la regressione&nbsp;</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><b>windows()</b> # apre e inizializza una nuova finestra grafica</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;">#</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">iso &lt;- gpava(ais$ferr, ais$hg, solver=weighted.mean, ties="secondary")</span></b> # calcola la regressione isotòna</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;">#</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">plot(iso, main="Regressione monotòna (isotòna)", xlab="Ferritina in µg/L", ylab="Emoglobina in g/dL", col="red")</span></b> # riporta il grafico con la distribuzione dei dati e sovrappone la regressione</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;">#</div></div></div></div></div></div><div></div></div></div></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">Impieghiamo quindi il pacchetto <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">isotone</span></b> per calcolare la regressione isotòna&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">con la funzione <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">gpava</span></b></span><span style="font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;che prevede come argomenti:</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">→ il valore in ascisse, nel nostro caso <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">ais$ferr</span></b>;</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">→ il valore in ordinate, nel nostro caso <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">ais$hg</span></b>;</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">→ l'argomento <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">solver</span></b> che consente di approssimare i dati impiegando la media (</span><span style="text-align: left;"><span style="color: #cc0000; font-family: verdana;"><b>weighted.mean</b></span></span><span style="font-family: verdana;">), la mediana (</span><span style="text-align: left;"><span style="color: #cc0000; font-family: verdana;"><b>weighted.median</b></span></span><span style="font-family: verdana;">), i frattili (</span><span style="text-align: left;"><span style="color: #cc0000; font-family: verdana;"><b>weighted.fractile</b></span></span><span style="font-family: verdana;">) pesati (qui i singoli pesi non sono specificati quindi per default sono uguali a 1);</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">→ l'argomento <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">ties</span></b> che consente di gestire l'ordinamento dei dati nel caso di valori identici</span><span style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">, con <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">"primary"</span></b> l'ordinamento viene effettuato tra i blocchi di dati identici, non all'interno di questi, con&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">"secondary"</span></b> l'ordinamento viene effettuato tra i blocchi di dati identici, ma viene richiesta l'uguaglianza dei valori all'interno di questi, con&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">"tertiary"</span></b> viene effettuato solamente l'ordinamento delle medie dei blocchi di dati identici.</span></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">Nell'oggetto <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">iso</span></b>&nbsp;generato dalla funzione <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">gpava</span></b> sono contenute tutte le informazioni necessarie per riportare in un grafico&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">con la funzione&nbsp;</span><b style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="color: #cc0000;">plot()</span></b><span style="font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">dati e regressione,</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;quindi è sufficiente aggiungere semplicemente titolo, legende e colore (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">"red"</span></b>) della regressione.</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><br /></div><div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"><a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgeVHr21tkzH1TzbrSVEBGnVoFi8P-46Se7LuNMpR3xQ92NPNDiBhRqqTIYpy4xkmSSydsHZ0u4peDC1E9j7pVKDbmGqNPV1EYkets5WcqDkImYxIzP6yorz31SK19Q_jUr-aCfgEMu8o3iqW8Nkhmg2uLaZbWhW8Il0LnuhrDrCOOKDtVv2MqS83TUr64q/s708/U220G_reg_isotone&amp;monregB.png" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"><img border="0" data-original-height="708" data-original-width="690" height="400" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgeVHr21tkzH1TzbrSVEBGnVoFi8P-46Se7LuNMpR3xQ92NPNDiBhRqqTIYpy4xkmSSydsHZ0u4peDC1E9j7pVKDbmGqNPV1EYkets5WcqDkImYxIzP6yorz31SK19Q_jUr-aCfgEMu8o3iqW8Nkhmg2uLaZbWhW8Il0LnuhrDrCOOKDtVv2MqS83TUr64q/w390-h400/U220G_reg_isotone&amp;monregB.png" width="390" /></a></div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">Nel caso di una regressione una cosa che interessa è impiegare la funzione calcolata per interpolare nuovi valori, per farlo&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">copiate e incollate nella</span><span style="font-family: courier; text-align: left;">&nbsp;Console di R&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">questo breve addendum allo script.</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><br /></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><div style="text-align: left;"><div style="text-align: justify;"><div style="background: rgb(221, 221, 221); border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"># interpolazione lineare sulla regressione isotòna calcolata in precedenza</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;">#</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">ris &lt;- as.data.frame(cbind(z=iso$z, y=iso$x))</span></b> # riporta in una tabella i dati della regressione</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">risord &lt;- ris[order(ris$z),]</span></b> # ordina la tabella</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;">#</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">reg &lt;- approx(risord$z, risord$y, xout=c(15, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 110, 120, 150, 170, 190, 220), ties="ordered")</span></b> # interpola i valori specificati</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;">#</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">round(cbind(reg$x, reg$y), digits=1)</span></b> # mostra i risultati dell'interpolazione</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;">#</div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div><div></div></div></div></span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><div><span style="text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">Dopo avere riportato i dati della regressione in una tabella e avere ordinato i valori in ascisse in ordine crescente&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">(prerequisito indispensabile per effettuare una interpolazione), i valori di emoglobina</span></span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">&nbsp;corrispondenti a</span><span style="font-family: courier; text-align: left;">&nbsp;15, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 110, 120, 150, 170, 190, 220&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">µg/L di ferritina&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">sono calcolati mediante <b>interpolazione lineare</b> sui dati della regressione isotòna con la funzione <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">approx()</span></b> (terza riga di codice) e sono quindi mostrati (quarta riga) arrotondandoli a un decimale.</span></div><div style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="text-align: left;"><br /></span></div><div><span style="color: #cc0000; font-family: courier;">&gt; round(cbind(reg$x, reg$y), digits=1) # mostra i risultati dell'interpolazione</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; [,1] [,2]</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;[1,]&nbsp; &nbsp;15 13.5</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;[2,]&nbsp; &nbsp;20 13.5</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;[3,]&nbsp; &nbsp;40 14.4</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;[4,]&nbsp; &nbsp;60 14.4</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;[5,]&nbsp; &nbsp;80 14.7</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;[6,]&nbsp; 100 14.9</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;[7,]&nbsp; 110 14.9</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;[8,]&nbsp; 120 14.9</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;[9,]&nbsp; 150 15.3</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">[10,]&nbsp; 170 15.3</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">[11,]&nbsp; 190 15.9</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">[12,]&nbsp; 220 15.9</span></div><div style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></div><div style="font-family: verdana;"><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">I&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">valori da interpolare riportati nell'argomento&nbsp;</span><b style="text-align: left;"><span style="color: #cc0000;">xout=c()</span></b><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">&nbsp;vanno ovviamente adattati al bisogno. In ogni caso se&nbsp;</span><span style="text-align: left;">volete verificare la correttezza del calcolo potete farlo riportando sul grafico i risultati dell'interpolazione con questa semplice riga di codice</span></div></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><div style="background: rgb(221, 221, 221); border: none; break-inside: avoid; font-family: verdana; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"># riporta sul grafico i punti interpolati</div><div style="background: rgb(221, 221, 221); border: none; break-inside: avoid; font-family: verdana; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;">#</div><div style="background: rgb(221, 221, 221); border: none; break-inside: avoid; font-family: verdana; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">points(reg$x, reg$y, pch=16, col="blue")</span></b>&nbsp;</div><div style="background-color: #dddddd; font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">#</div></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">e questi sono i punti interpolati riportati sulla regressione isotòna calcolata.</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: center;"><a href="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEh7C3xlIgqsYlTlUEV2416dclN2uTFZioON3kYH5kE3ezdaKOsdtm_tLtGAcOWC20VXd4ANUVOcZPdlAs_PEk4odZY5tQcLbEWYbFGpfsg5sDXiUA369QyGcP3KJ_R7pwmoHkliJav0ckoEVQgJh_xb5_GH67ycZTU7cgGMF2pJJia-HwiqcKK8Do8CMG4K/s711/U220G_reg_isotonaB1.png" style="margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;"><img border="0" data-original-height="711" data-original-width="689" height="400" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEh7C3xlIgqsYlTlUEV2416dclN2uTFZioON3kYH5kE3ezdaKOsdtm_tLtGAcOWC20VXd4ANUVOcZPdlAs_PEk4odZY5tQcLbEWYbFGpfsg5sDXiUA369QyGcP3KJ_R7pwmoHkliJav0ckoEVQgJh_xb5_GH67ycZTU7cgGMF2pJJia-HwiqcKK8Do8CMG4K/w388-h400/U220G_reg_isotonaB1.png" width="388" /></a></div><br /></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">Per meglio sviluppare il tema vediamo ora la regressione calcolata con un metodo diverso, previsto nel pacchetto <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">monreg</span></b>,&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">copiate e incollate nella</span><span style="font-family: courier; text-align: left;">&nbsp;Console di R&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">questo script</span><span style="background-color: white; font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;</span><span style="background-color: white; font-family: verdana;">e premete</span><span style="background-color: white;"><span style="font-family: courier;">&nbsp;↵ Invio</span></span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">.</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><br /></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><div style="text-align: left;"><div style="text-align: justify;"><div style="background: rgb(221, 221, 221); border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"># REGRESSIONE&nbsp;<span style="text-align: left;">MONOTÒNA (ISOTÒNA)</span>&nbsp;con il pacchetto monreg&nbsp;</span></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">#</span></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><b>library(DAAG)</b> # carica il pacchetto che include il set di dati ais</span></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><b>library(<span style="color: #cc0000;">monreg</span>)</b> # carica il pacchetto per la regressione&nbsp;</span></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><b>windows()</b> # apre e inizializza una nuova finestra grafica</span></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">#</span></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">mon &lt;- monreg(ais$ferr, ais$hg, hd=.5, hr=.5, monotonie="isoton")</span></b> # calcola la regressione isotòna</span></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">#</span></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">plot(ais$ferr, ais$hg, main="Regressione monotòna (isotòna)", xlab="Ferritina in µg/L", ylab="Emoglobina in g/dL")</span></b> # riporta il grafico con la distribuzione dei dati</span></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">lines(mon$t, mon$estimation, col="red")</span></b> # sovrappone la regressione&nbsp;</span></div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">#</span></div></div></div></div></div></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div></div></div></div></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">In questo caso </span><span style="font-family: verdana;">il passo più interessante si trova nella funzione <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">monreg()</span></b>&nbsp;ed è l'argomento <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">monotonie</span></b> che consente di selezionare le due soluzioni possibili per una <b>regressione monotòna</b>:</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">→ con&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">"isoton"</span></b> si calcola la <b>regressione isotòna</b> (crescente o sempre non decrescente) come facciamo in questo caso;</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">→ con <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">"antiton"</span></b> si calcola la <b>regressione antitòna</b> (decrescente o sempre non crescente), che è trattata a parte in un altro post [8].</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">Per gli altri argomenti della funzione rimando alla guida specifica richiamabile digitando <span style="color: #cc0000; font-weight: bold;">help(monreg)</span> nella</span><span style="font-family: courier;"> Console di R</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">.</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">Infine con&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">plot()</span></b>&nbsp;si riporta il grafico</span><span style="font-family: courier;">&nbsp;xy&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">dei dati e con&nbsp;<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">lines()</span></b>&nbsp;si sovrappone la regressione le cui ascisse (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">mon$t</span></b>) e ordinate (<b><span style="color: #cc0000;">mon$estimation</span></b>) sono state in precedenza salvate nell'oggetto <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">mon</span></b> generato con la funzione <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">monreg()</span></b>. Digitate <span style="color: #cc0000;"><b>str(mon)</b></span>&nbsp;nella</span><span style="font-family: courier;"> Console di R </span><span style="font-family: verdana;">per visualizzare tutte le variabili salvate da <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">monreg()</span></b> nell'oggetto <b><span style="color: #cc0000;">mon</span></b>.</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><br /></div><div class="separator" style="clear: both; text-align: left;">&nbsp;Console di R&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">questo breve addendum allo script che riporta nuovamente –&nbsp;</span></span><span style="font-family: verdana;">in quanto lievemente diverso e più semplice del precedente poiché la funzione </span><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">monreg()</span></b><span style="font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;restituisce i dati con la</span><span style="font-family: courier;"> x </span><span style="font-family: verdana;">già ordinata in ordine crescente</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">&nbsp;– il codice necessario per effettuare l'interpolazione sulla regressione calcolata.</span></div></span><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><div style="text-align: left;"><div style="text-align: justify;"><div style="background: rgb(221, 221, 221); text-align: left;">valori di emoglobina corrispondenti a</span><span style="font-family: courier; text-align: left;">&nbsp;15, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 110, 120, 150, 170, 190, 220&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">µg/L di ferritina sono calcolati mediante interpolazione lineare&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">sui dati della regressione isotòna&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">con la funzione&nbsp;</span><b style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;"><span style="color: #cc0000;">approx()</span></b><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">(prima riga di codice), quindi sono mostrati (seconda riga).</span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div></div><div></div></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><div><span style="color: #cc0000; 110 14.9</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;[8,]&nbsp; 120 15.0</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; font-family: courier;">&nbsp;[9,]&nbsp; 150 15.2</span></div><div><span style="color: #3d85c6; text-align: left;">volete verificare la correttezza del calcolo potete riportare sul grafico i risultati dell'interpolazione, per farlo c</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">opiate e incollate nella</span><span style="font-family: courier; text-align: left;">&nbsp;Console di R&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana; text-align: left;">questa riga di codice, identica a quella già vista a conclusione dello script precedente.</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"># riporta sul grafico i punti interpolati</div><div style="background: rgb(221, 221, 221); border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;">#</div><div style="background: rgb(221, 221, 221); border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><b><span>points(reg$x, reg$y, pch=16, col="blue")</span></b>&nbsp;</div><div style="background: rgb(221, 221, 221); border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;">#</div></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">Tuttavia la cosa più interessante in questo caso è probabilmente il confronto diretto tra la regressione isotòna così calcolata e la regressione lineare standard, cosa che può essere agevolmenta fatta copiando e incollando nella</span><span style="font-family: courier;"> Console di R </span><span style="font-family: verdana;">queste due ultime righe di codice</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><br /></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><div style="background: rgb(221, 221, 221); border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;">#&nbsp;</div><div style="background: rgb(221, 221, 221); border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm; text-align: left;"><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">reglin &lt;- lm(ais$hg ~ ais$ferr)</span></b> # calcola la regressione lineare</div><div style="background-attachment: initial; background-clip: initial; background-image: initial; background-origin: initial; background-position: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-size: initial; border: none; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm;"><b><span style="color: #cc0000;">abline(reglin, col="green3")</span></b> # traccia la retta calcolata</div><div>#</div></div></span></div><div><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">con questo risultato finale (retta di regressione in colore verde)</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><div class="separator" style="clear: both; margin-right: 1em;"><img border="0" data-original-height="712" data-original-width="688" height="400" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEiPN2xAuyVMlipw1PyY22noBD3VC75jwzHQmk6OlkmhJsClqvtxOVzg6dKzVKHN0LKFZtjtgCMTjfz3Hk12clIc61OTVpT-ba87P75-ESxiG2mLJL_RkXEj2tM0xVULCPICli28VwjeMcin9q3GKSDjzs8SfUjPDRaoKVk9WtvOmcOli7vLjF1NH6KajBFf/w386-h400/U220G_reg_isotonaC1.png" width="386" /></a></div><br /><span style="font-family: verdana;">che conferma l'impressione che, in questo specifico caso, e con questo specifico pacchetto, la regressione isotòna corrisponde in larga parte a una regressione lineare, dalla quale tende peraltro a discostarsi significativamente nelle regioni più esterne.</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><br /></div><div style="text-align: center;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">----------</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">[1]&nbsp;</span><span style="font-family: verdana;">Nella letteratura statistica anglosassone trovate "</span><i style="font-family: verdana;">isotonic</i><span style="font-family: verdana;">" che talora viene erroneamente considerato sinonimo di "<i>monotonic</i>". Qui "<i>monotòna</i>" viene riportato con il significato matematico originario di "<i>funzione che non ha massimi e non ha minimi</i>" mentre "<i>isotòna</i>" e "<i>antitòna</i>" sono gli attributi aggiuntivi di una funzione monotòna quando è rispettivamente una "<i>funzione crescente o sempre non decrescente</i>" e quando è una "<i>funzione decrescente o sempre non crescente</i>".</span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;"><br /></span></div><div style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-family: verdana;">[2] de Leeuw, J., Hornik, K., &amp; Mair, P.
